title: Cookie policy

seo.title: Cookie Policy
seo.description: Which cookies the StarOrigin website uses, why, and how to change your cookie preferences.

draftNotice: Draft template — to be reviewed and approved by StarOrigin's legal counsel before publishing.
intro: This policy explains how StarOrigin uses cookies and similar technologies on its website. It should be read alongside our Privacy policy.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.html: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They let the site remember your actions and preferences and help us understand how the site is used. Similar technologies — such as local storage and pixels — work in comparable ways, and we refer to all of them as "cookies" here.

sections.heading: 2. Cookies we use
sections.html:

We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies. A detailed list of individual cookie names and providers will be published here once the production site is configured. sample

sections.heading: 3. Consent
sections.html: When you first visit, we ask for your choice on optional cookies. Analytics and functional cookies are set only if you accept them. Declining does not affect your ability to browse jobs, submit a CV or contact us.

sections.heading: 4. How to change your preferences
sections.html:
• On our site: use the "Cookie settings" link in the footer sample to review or change your choice at any time.
  • In your browser: most browsers let you block or delete cookies through their privacy settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies may stop parts of the site from working.
  • Analytics opt-out: some analytics providers offer their own opt-out tools, which you can use in addition to our settings.
Changing your preferences takes effect from that point forward. Cookies already set may remain on your device until they expire or you delete them in your browser.

sections.heading: 5. Third-party content
sections.html: Pages that embed third-party content — such as fonts, maps or social sharing links — may allow those providers to set their own cookies or receive technical data like your IP address. Their use is governed by their own policies.

sections.heading: 6. Contact
sections.html:
Questions about cookies? Write to hello@starorigin.in.
